luminol.fixes.item_multitask.enabled.com:
Prevent the server from interrupting the state of items

luminol.fixes.pathfinding_fixes.break_do: Recompute path or stop pathfinding when it's touching the blocks out of current tick region
luminol.fixes.pathfinding_fixes.do_not_p: Skip pathfinding target when it's out of current tick region
luminol.fixes.poi_range_fixes.do_not_com:

luminol.fixes.allow_unsafe_teleportation:

If you want to use sand duping,please turn on this.

luminol.function.portal_rate_limit.enabl: Whether or not to limit the portal rate when entity goes into portals
luminol.function.portal_rate_limit.maxim:
Decides how much portal teleportation should be handled within a tick in a single tick region,when exceed,
the portal teleportation will be pushed into the next tick

Note: set to -1 to use custom expressions

If the fixed limit is not enough for use, you could define your own expression to dynamically limit theportal rate.

Available variables(all is of current tickregion): e (ticking_entity_count)
c (ticking_chunk_count)
p (player_count)
Example: 50 * (1 + sqrt(x/1000) + c/200 + p/5)
luminol.function.region_format.linear_co: Decides the compression level of the region file(Only works for LINEAR_V2 and B_LINEAR)
luminol.function.region_format.linear_io: Decides the worker thread count of linear(Only works for LINEAR_V2)
Decides when it will be flushed to the region file when it has been marked to save for n(default is 100) milliseconds(Only works for LINEAR_V2)
luminol.function.region_format.blinear_i: Decides when it will be flushed to the region file when there has been no write operations for n(default is 3000) milliseconds(Only works for B_LINEAR)
Decides the worker thread count of buffered linear(Only works for B_LINEAR)
luminol.function.region_format.linear_us: Decides if it could use virtual threads for linear format(Only works for LINEAR_V2)
luminol.function.secure_seed.enabled.com:
Once you enable secure seed, all ores and structures are generated with 1024-bit seed
instead of using 64-bit seed in vanilla, making traditional seed cracking impossible.
Note: If you use V1 it will be vulnerable to terrain elevation attacks.
***** WARN: You need keep it enabled if your old world are also using secure seed! Or it will kill your save *****
luminol.function.secure_seed.version.com:
Version 1: Blake2b (insecure, reversible with a GPU/ASIC cluster in minutes with enough entropy)
Version 2: Blake3 with salt key derivation (recommended, irreversible)
***** WARN: Switching versions will cause chunk errors! *****
luminol.function.secure_seed.salt.commen:
Auto-generated 256-bit salt for V2 cryptographic operations.
Generated once on first startup - DO NOT SHARE THIS OR MODIFY (MODIFYING THIS WILL CAUSE CHUNK ERRORS)!
Used with Blake3 keyed hash to make seed irreversible.
luminol.misc.auto_update.comment:
Checks GitHub Releases for newer version's jars on a schedule.
Downloads are staged under auto_update/lophine and written to auto_update/core.path,
which Hyacinthusclip can consume on the next restart.
If target_jar_path is set, server will also try to replace that launcher jar directly.
luminol.misc.auto_update.enabled.comment: Whether the server should check for updates automatically.
luminol.misc.auto_update.check_times.com: List of daily check times in HH:mm, based on the server's local time zone.
luminol.misc.auto_update.allow_prereleas: Whether prerelease GitHub releases are allowed when selecting an update.
luminol.misc.auto_update.target_jar_path:
Optional launcher jar path to replace after a successful download.
Leave this blank to keep the downloaded jar staged in auto_update/lophine
and let Hyacinthusclip switch to it through auto_update/core.path on restart.

luminol.misc.disable_warning.disable_mov: Disable wrongly move warns and checks
luminol.misc.folia_watchdog.tick_region_: Decides the interval of the watchdog prints the threads dumps of tickregions in stuck

luminol.misc.server_mod_name.name.commen: Decides the server mod name shown in your F3 debug screen.

luminol.optimizations.cpu_affinity.enabl:
Using this you could pin the threads of tick region scheduler(Following are the same) to cpu cores listed in the config 'tickregion_affinity' following,
which is useful for those CPU with P and E cores (such as 12/13/14 gen Intel Core CPUs and so on.)
luminol.optimizations.cpu_affinity.tickr: The core number you want the tick region threads to bind on
luminol.optimizations.throttle_goal_sele:
Throttles the AI goal selector in entity inactive ticks.
This can improve performance by a few percent, but has minor gameplay implications.
luminol.optimizations.variable_entity_wa:
If this value is set to any value > 0, waking up inactive entities happens spread over time, instead of many entities at once. This makes entities feel and behave more natural.
This setting is the coefficient of variation, or σ / μ (the ratio of the standard deviation to the mean) of the inactivity duration.

In other words, this setting is the value σ, so that the regular inactivity duration will be multiplied by a factor normal_distribution(μ = 1, σ).
If a value ≤ 0 is given, variable entity wake-up is disabled.
luminol.optimizations.lithium_sleeping_b:

luminol.optimizations.reduce_sensor_work: When it is enabled, it will delete the line of sight cache less often and use a faster nearby comparison.
The interval of each entity to drop the cache(in ticks)
luminol.optimizations.projectile.max-loa: Controls how many chunks are allowed to be sync loaded by projectiles in a tick.

Due to Paper's modification of the merge radius,
when the merge radius is large and stacks containing many items get stuck in an unexpected position, 
individual items may never reach their destination.
This configuration option is added to fix this behavior.

lophine_carpet.carpet.general.comment:
Carpet/AMS/TIS/Org compatibility rules backed by existing Lophine features.
Only rules that already have a working server-side implementation are exposed here.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.language.c:
Carpet language value.
ATTENTION: This config will not update in Lophine global now!
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.dustTrapdo:
Should the pre-1.20 mechanism be reintroduced:
Redstone dust does not connect to adjacent redstone dust on trapdoors that are open
Pre-1.20.2 mechanism: Redstone dust, redstone repeaters, 
and redstone comparators do not check for attachment when receiving status updates from below.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.creativeNo:
Whether to enable creative fly no clip.
When enabled, players in creative mode will not collide with blocks while flying.
This allows them to pass through blocks without obstruction.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.antiSpamDi: Disable the server-side chat and creative-drop spam throttles used by vanilla/Spigot.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.blockPlace: Allow creative players to place blocks without entity collision checks.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.creativeOp: Allow creative players to forcibly open blocked chests, ender chests and shulker boxes.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.creativeOn:
Allow creative players to instantly kill attackable non-creative, non-spectator entities.
Sneaking expands the effect into a small area attack.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.bambooMode: Remove the random horizontal model offset from bamboo and bamboo saplings.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.creativeNo: Skip item cooldown application for creative players.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.ctrlQCraft: Compatibility flag for the upstream result-slot Ctrl+Q crafting fix already present in the current menu code.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.carpetAlwa: Compatibility flag for Lophine's config loader, which already writes default values into the compat config during preload.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.placementR: Use the player's main body rotation for placement direction checks instead of interpolated head yaw.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tntDoNotUp: Prevent TNT from checking redstone power when first placed.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.totallyNoB: Suppress neighbor and shape updates globally for block changes.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tiscmNetwo: Enable the native Carpet TIS Addition network channel on `tiscm:network/v1`.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.hopperNoIt: Restore the transferred stack into a hopper when a wool block is placed on top of it.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.explosionN: Let explosions damage entities without breaking blocks.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.noGhastBlo: Disables ghast fireball explosion block breaking.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.disableBla: Disables fire made from blaze fireballs.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.disableGha: Disables fire made from ghast fireballs.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.optimizedT: Compatibility flag for the already optimized server explosion path carried by the current runtime.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tntPrimerM: Remove the random horizontal launch momentum from newly primed TNT.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tntIgnoreR: Ignore redstone power when deciding whether TNT should auto-prime.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tntDupingF: Toggle the piston desync path used by vanilla TNT duplication setups.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.interactio:
Control whether player interaction block changes emit normal block updates.
Set to false to suppress neighbor and shape updates during block use and breaking.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.xpNoCooldo: Allow players to absorb multiple experience orbs in the same tick without pickup delay.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.powerfulEx: Let picked-up experience repair all damaged mending items in the player's inventory, not only equipped gear.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.clientSett: Reapply the player's last known client settings after respawn.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.sensibleEn: Restrict enderman block pickup to pumpkins and melons only.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.entityInst: Remove the normal 20gt delay before dead living entities are discarded.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.farmlandTr: Prevent farmland from turning into dirt when entities land on it.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.shulkerGol: Allow a carved pumpkin on top of a shulker box to summon a shulker.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.preventEnd: Skip obsidian spike regeneration during dragon respawn.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.yeetOutOfO: Ignore out-of-order secure chat chain checks instead of invalidating the chat session.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.betterCraf: Add the AMS alternate bone block recipe that yields 3 bone blocks from 9 bones.
Add the AMS alternate dispenser recipes using a dropper.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.viewDistan: Override the dedicated server's startup view distance with the Carpet-compatible value.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tickComman:
Override the `/tick` command permission level.
Accepts values in the range 0..4, where 2 matches old Carpet behavior and 3 keeps vanilla.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tickFreeze: Make `/tick freeze` toggle back to running when executed while the server is already frozen.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.syncServer: Broadcast live MSPT samples through the native TISCM protocol channel.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.simpleInGa: Evaluate chat messages prefixed with `=` as a simple calculator expression and reply privately.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.microTimin: Compatibility flag for the built-in region profiler and timing instrumentation carried by Folia/Moonrise.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.fastRedsto: Route redstone dust updates through the Alternate Current fast-update backend.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.lagFreeSpa: Use the lightweight collision and precooked-mob spawning path for natural spawning checks.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.optimizedF: Compatibility flag for the always-on Moonrise/Paper fast entity movement collision pipeline.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.optimizedH: Compatibility flag for the always-on Moonrise/Paper hard-hitbox entity collision optimizations.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.tntFuseDur:
Override the default primed TNT fuse duration in ticks.
Accepts values in the range 0..32767.
lophine_carpet.carpet.general.defaultLog:
Carpet-style default logger subscriptions for players.
Examples: ["tps", "mob_caps", "counter white"]
lophine_carpet.carpet.hopper_counter.hop: Enable the existing wool hopper counter implementation.

Remove the hopper transfer speed limit for counters.
Only effective when hopperCounters is enabled.
